clips.send: A planet and its star both orbit their shared center of mass. When the star moves toward us its light waves are squeezed and its spectral lines shift toward blue; when it moves away they stretch toward red. That’s the Doppler effect. The first planet found around a Sun-like star, 51 Pegasi b (1995), was found this way.

clips.send: 行星和恒星都绕着它们共同的质量中心转。恒星朝我们移动时，它的光波被压缩，谱线向蓝端移动（蓝移）；离开我们时，光波被拉长，谱线向红端移动（红移）。这就是多普勒效应。1995 年发现的第一颗绕类太阳恒星的行星“飞马座 51b”就是这样找到的。
